fields.label: Feature Role
fields.description: Leave blank to allow this geometry type under any role.

fields.label: Layer Name
fields.description: Human label for this (geometry type, feature role) combination, e.g. "Farm Boundary", "Sensors", "Water Pump". Optional — blank means no specific layer assignment for this combo.

fields.label: Color
fields.description: Map styling color for this layer.

fields.label: Marker Icon
fields.description: Font Awesome 6 solid icon name (e.g. "map-pin", "water", "warehouse") for point-geometry layers. Blank/unused for lines and polygons.
